title: Lacson: Due process for Dela Rosa does not mean shielding him from ICC
summary: Sen. Panfilo Lacson on Tuesday, November 3 reiterated Sen. Ronald dela Rosa has the right to due process, but clarified that this does not mean shielding him from the International Criminal Court,…

blocks.text: Sen. Panfilo Lacson on Tuesday, November 3 reiterated Sen. Ronald dela Rosa has the right to due process, but clarified that this does not mean shielding him from the International Criminal Court, which has ordered his arrest.
